title: [Latest DEV] No Pump and OpenAPS info on NS15 with NSclientV3
symptom: With NSClient V3, no Pump and OpenAPS info is sent to Nightscout, and predictive lines are not shown in the latest BG reading dot. The user also notes that xDrip sends BG values to NS because AAPS doesn't send them even when selected in NS options.
cause: The token for the admin role was not set after migrating to a new server.
fix: Create a new token and set it for the admin role on the new server.
evidence_quote: I just realized since I migrated to a new server I didn't set the token for admin role, issue now solved!!
